scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/opencode-plugin-send-message-across-sessions build && bun run --cwd packages/opencode-plugin-image-gen build && bun run --cwd packages/opencode-plugin-prompt-search build && bun run --cwd packages/opencode-plugin-unicorn build
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run --workspaces --if-present test
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bun run --workspaces --if-present typecheck
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:packaged
scripts.publish:all: bun run check && npm version --ws patch && bun run build && npm login --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org && npm publish --ws
